meta.source: Federal Reserve, 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances, Table 2 (family net worth by age of reference person, 2022 dollars)
meta.note: The SCF's published age brackets (<35 / 35-44 / 45-54 / 55-64 / 65-74 / 75-or-more) don't line up one-to-one with this app's six age bands: under25 and 25-34 both borrow the <35 bracket (SCF doesn't break out under-25 households separately), and 65plus is an unweighted average of the 65-74 and 75-or-more brackets. lib/usIncomeCalc.ts rescales by average/mean (not median) here to match overallUsNetWorth.average in data/us/netWorthPercentilesUS.json and the group-relative percentile convention this app uses elsewhere.
